reference_selection: minimum 3-fold calibration NLL across all controls, raw, intercept
candidate_selection: minimum calibration NLL across spectral learner, spectral plus controls, offset spectral, and budgets .25,.5,1,2
gate: equal mixture of nine constant bets and one predictable adaptive bet; fixed-sample threshold M/alpha
primary_endpoint: paired assessment log-loss gain versus frozen selected reference
notes: Local timestamp and hashes establish an audit trail, not an independent preregistration.
data_integrity_amendment: Exact normalized-waveform deduplication; omit audit matches to training and retain first audit occurrence independent of labels. Original row IDs determine splits. Original records preserved, excluded from primary analysis.
gate_order_correction: Use a label-independent SHA256(SEB-v2:gate-order:dataset:original_id) ordering for adaptive bets; original source order may be class-sorted. Specified before inspection of new-suite gate outcomes or assessment results.
